decisions.reason: Locating the VBACKUP pad beside the existing PWROK access point does not change the PWROK breakout or its debugging purpose.
The no-population instruction applies specifically to a future VBACKUP component and does not alter the charge-status LED circuit or population rules.
VRTC handling is addressed by a separate clause and already has same-message lifecycle Events; the VBACKUP access change does not further modify VRTC state.
The VBACKUP breakout location and population decision does not change the panel power-button connector or PWRON behavior.
The referenced VBACKUP test pad is unrelated to the AXP2101 underside thermal pad and stencil implementation.
Exposing VBACKUP beside PWROK does not alter ESP32 decoupling capacitance or placement.
Optional future backup power for the AXP2101 internal RTC does not change the established normal-operation power source, rails, charging behavior, or battery-efficiency goal.
The optional VBACKUP capacitor, supercapacitor, or coin-cell connection does not modify the main battery's overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal protection requirements.
The VBACKUP access change does not affect the MT3608 rail, its GPIO control, or its sensor loads.
The optional future component on VBACKUP is not a change to the existing AXP2101 or MT3608 converter-decoupling placement requirement.
Providing optional RTC backup-power access does not change the ESP32 sleep policy, wake sources, or wake intervals.
A possible future backup capacitor, supercapacitor, or coin cell on VBACKUP does not change the main J_BAT connector family, pin count, pin functions, or unresolved pin order.
